messages.content: Write solve(x) in one Python code block. The standard library and any explicitly listed optional callables are available.

x is INI text with one section per event, each containing label and value, in arrival order. Labels are short words and readings are signed integers from -7 to 7. Write solve(x). Return a dictionary that will map each observed label to its largest reading minus its smallest reading. Empty input gives an empty dictionary. For example x = '[event0]
label = ivy
value = 4

[event1]
label = oak
value = -1

[event2]
label = ivy
value = 1

[event3]
label = oak
value = -1

[event4]
label = ivy
value = 1

' gives {'ivy': 3, 'oak': 0}.
